about: Every feature of the Freally OS docs site, one tagged spec each, driven over CDP in headless Chrome by tools/cdp-runner --site. A feature without a spec, or a spec without a feature, fails the run.

features.what: Every page in all 18 languages: the page says its language and direction, and every string the site translates shows that language's translation, with no page error.
The site's one look, the fleet's dark ground, on every page and language.
Nothing to download before 1.0: no download link, installer or image anywhere.
No private document is served or quoted: no Markdown, the planning documents answer 404, no task ids.
The fleet cursor: the ring and its dot replace the arrow, the dot sits on the pointer, the ring grows over a link and shrinks while pressed.
Every toggle wears the fleet's looks (off gray, on Freally green); the site has none today.
